products.name: Tsuyu Matcha
products.description: “Tsuyu” means dew, referring to the dew that is often found early in the morning in the hills of Okuyame, a subregion of Yame, Fukuoka, where this delightful matcha was produced. Crafted from the Saemidori and Kirari 31 cultivars, this tea undergoes a more intensive "hiire" firing, locking in a nutty, toasty fragrance and a chocolaty, creamy finish.

products.name: House Matcha
products.description: The plants used to produce this lovely lot were shaded, amplifying both the sweetness and the umami character in the cup.

products.name: Silver Needles
products.description: Silver Needle is a type of white tea made with only buds. White tea production typically involves two steps: withering and drying. Due to the nature of this minimal processing, white tea showcases the varietal and terroir more than any other tea type. Harvested in March of each year, this particular lot from Jinggu is made from the Yang Ta varietal, and it presents lovely notes of vanilla, citrus, and stone fruit.

products.name: Ogura Matcha
products.description: Ogura matcha is named after the small sub-region of Uji where this tea was grown. It is primarily composed of the Samidori cultivar with a touch of Uji Hikari. The tencha (pre-ground tea leaf) was exclusively produced in Ogura and was expertly blended by a 12th generation Chashi (tea-blender). A special aging process called “jukusei” imbues the tea with a rich, almost fruity tomato-like aroma.

products.name: Miyuki
products.description: A competition and exceptional ceremonial-grade organic matcha. A must-have for all matcha lovers. Perfectly balanced, low-key astringency and packed with umami, this first-flush matcha is a pure delight.

products.name: Itsuki
products.description: ITSUKI is an elegant, light-bodied matcha, with subdued umami and a faint bitterness. Its creamy texture is elevated by its notes of pistachio and roasted flavor profile.

products.name: Tsuyoshi
products.description: An outstanding premium matcha, packed with caffeine and theanine for maximum focus and energy. Sweet and fragrant with a touch of bitterness.

products.name: Koji
products.description: A premium organic tamaryokucha from Oita with notes of toasted hazelnut and Brussels sprouts accented by subtle nuances of dried mango and magnolia. First harvest tea.

products.name: Shino
products.description: This award-winning, competition-grade kamairicha takes you on a unique flavor journey. Enjoy its sweetness, chestnut and fruity notes.

products.name: Orchid Dancong
products.description: A premium Oolong tea sourced from Phoenix Mountain in Chaozhou, China. Orchid Dancong delivers a naturally vibrant floral aroma of fresh orchids, paired with notes of sweet honey and a smooth, lingering finish.

products.name: Meizhan Yancha
products.description: Yancha, or Rock Teas, are grown in the cracks of the rocks in the Wuyi Mountains, where the soil is rich with minerals like potassium, zinc, and selenium. This unique terroir imparts a distinct minerality and complexity. The Meizhan cultivar, originating from Anxi, is often known for its floral aroma in the cup.

products.name: Okumidori
products.description: Okumidori Limited Reserve - A rare organic Japanese cultivar prized for its depth and elegant expression of matcha.

products.name: Saemidori
products.description: Saemidori Limited Reserve - A rare organic Japanese cultivar celebrated by connoisseurs.

products.name: Reishi Mushroom
products.description: A premium wellness blend combining 100% organic Latte Grade Japanese matcha from Uji with nutrient-rich Hokkaido reishi mushrooms. Unsweetened and dairy-free, this functional powder supports immunity and clean energy. Perfectly designed for crafting smooth, healthy matcha lattes.

products.name: Ichiko
products.description: A fragrant, premium ceremonial-grade matcha from Sonogi. Silky and smooth with hints of roasted almonds, flower notes, and robust umami.

products.name: Masashi
products.description: Plucked during the first harvest in Hoshino, Yame, this ceremonial matcha is a premium blend of Yabukita and Okumidori cultivars. It offers a velvety smooth umami with nutty notes and a refreshing aroma.

products.name: Ayako
products.description: A hand-harvested and stone-milled Yame matcha using only the Yabukita cultivar. Features a smooth, silken texture with a bright bitterness, full mouthfeel, and lingering umami.

products.name: Ayame
products.description: An aromatic, stone-ground ceremonial matcha from Yame. Perfectly balanced with a vivid emerald green color, intense umami, low bitterness, and a full-bodied, creamy flavor.

products.name: Craft Matcha
products.description: From the renowned matcha region of Uji, Japan, we bring you ceremonial-grade Craft Matcha. Our Kyoto team explored the mountains of Japan to find a matcha that embodies the quality and taste we demand out of our coffee. We choose tender tea leaves from our producer’s first harvest of tencha, or shade-grown matcha plants, and stone-mill them to protect against heat degradation.

products.name: Yumiko
products.description: Crafted by koucha expert Okamoto san, YUMIKO is a refined Earl Grey-flavored Japanese black tea infused with bergamot oranges cultivated in Ureshino, Saga prefecture.

products.name: Yuki
products.description: A tasty organic koucha (Japanese black tea) flavored with lychee and blended with rose petals. A delicious and fragrant afternoon drink.

products.name: Matcha Sonogi
products.description: SONOGI is a blended matcha from a cooperative of four tea producers overlooking Ōmura Bay in Nagasaki prefecture, Japan. Yabukita and Tsuyu cultivar tea trees are shaded with nylon tarps for 21 days, machine-harvested, and processed to tencha before milling to a particle diameter of 10-12 microns. Expect prominent sweetness and round umami."

products.name: Matcha Wazuka
products.description: WAZUKA is a custom matcha from Wazuka, Kyoto prefecture, Japan. In this town of only 3,000, our farmer-partner Uejima-san blends his semi-wild Samidori tencha with gold-standard Yabukita material for the high sweetness and glossy body that typifies Uji matcha. Milled to-order in micro batches for deep freshness.

products.name: Matcha Kame
products.description: Kame is our pinnacle Matcha—an ultra-premium release from the same storied grower behind our beloved Matcha Wazuka. Harvested in early spring 2025 and meticulously rested under cold storage until 2026, Matcha Kame is a one-time offering of only 500 tins.

products.name: Champagne Long Kou oolong tea
products.description: CHAMPAGNE LONG KOU is our project dongfang meiren—also known (unfortunately) as "Oriental (or Eastern) Beauty", or simply Bai Hao. Less commonly, this tea is referred to as Champagne Oolong; a fitting title for a tea regularly sold at over 400USD per kilogram. We refer to it in-house as Mister Lei's Champagne—a nod to this tea's producer and our old friend Mingfu, a wine connoisseur with a nose for the subtleties of aroma dongfang meiren production requires. This is also the man behind our house jasmine. His teas are notoriously sweet and layered, and his latest production is no exception.
products.seo_title: Champagne Long Kou oolong tea | Related Tea |Offsite

images.alt_text: Champagne Long Kou oolong tea - Primary

products.name: Craft Hojicha
products.description: A gentle counterpoint to the vibrancy of matcha, Craft Hōjicha is a grounding, restorative ritual designed for moments of calm, whether enjoyed as an evening wind-down or a soothing morning latte. While most Japanese green teas are defined by their fresh, verdant notes, hōjicha finds its flavor in a specialized high-heat roasting process. This transformation removes any lingering bitterness, coaxing out a warm, natural sweetness with low caffeine and a sophisticated profile of toasty, nutty, and smoky caramel notes.

products.name: Agaro
products.description: Showcasing the rich heritage of Ethiopian coffee, this offering is sourced in partnership with Addis Exporter, reflecting a steadfast commitment to quality and transparency in every cup.

products.name: Cusco
products.description: Passenger’s Cusco partnership reflects a commitment to supporting coffee farming communities in Peru by fostering sustainably-focused growth and delivering exceptional, consistent coffees to customers year after year.

products.name: Los Sueños Decaf
products.description: Our Los Sueños Decaf is comprised of community lots from our producer partners in Divino Niño. These lots are Ethyl Acetate decaffeinated in Colombia before heading directly to our freezer storage facility in Lancaster.

products.name: Heza
products.description: Highlighting the exceptional work of the Long Miles Coffee Project, the complex and unique flavor profile of Burundian coffee is on full display in this Foundational offering comprised of coffees processed at the Heza washing station.

products.name: Mountain Harvest
products.description: Mountain Harvest is a beacon of change in Uganda's coffee sector, championing quality, sustainability, and equity for farmers. Since partnering in 2018, we've witnessed the remarkable evolution of their impact initiatives, resulting in coffees we love drinking and progress we're proud to support. This year’s offering, a blend from farms on Mount Elgon, sings with notes of citrus, ginger, and molasses.

products.name: Nueva Llusta
products.description: Members of the CENAPROC cooperative have long produced our favorite coffees from Bolivia. Over our 20+ year relationship, the organic coffees grown in the Yungas jungle of the country’s eastern mountains have consistently endured complicated logistical hurdles, making their quality all the more remarkable. This lot represents the best of these dedicated farmers, showcasing subtle cherry notes and a complex sweetness reminiscent of vanilla and hazelnut.

products.name: Mpemba
products.description: The village of Mpemba, a tiny and tranquil hamlet tucked into the rolling hills of Burundi’s Kayanza province, is home to the Kazoza N’Ikawa cooperative. In the Kirundi language, Kazoza N’Ikawa translates to “the future is coffee”—a name hinting at the commitment to quality exemplified by its members. The coffees we buy from the co-op are not only our favorites from Burundi but across the entire region. This washed lot exhibits all of the hallmarks that make Burundian coffees so unique. Look for juicy top notes of clementine intermingled with flavors of honey and a tea-like body.

products.name: La Golondrina
products.description: La Golondrina is a testament to the power of partnership. The Orgánica cooperative, unwavering in its commitment to sustainability, has produced our La Golondrina offering since 2007. This coffee has captured the hearts of our customers and has become our most popular single-origin offering. La Golondrina showcases quintessential Colombian coffee flavors, featuring a harmonious balance of zesty cherry, rich milk chocolate, and delightful nutty notes.

products.name: Huye Mountain, Rwanda
products.description: David Rubanzangabo operates the Huye Mountain washing station with an emphasis on community, and a strong dedication to the farmers it serves, resulting in a bright coffee with a fine, balanced acidity.

products.name: Bies Penantan, Indonesia
products.description: Crafted by the women-led Ketiara Cooperative in Aceh, Sumatra, this coffee showcases the care and expertise of its producers. Stumptown’s Indonesia Bies Penantan is rich and full-bodied, with notes of dark chocolate, toasted nuts, and a hint of earthy spice—a simple, flavorful cup that tells the story of its farmers and their craft.

products.name: El Injerto Bourbon, Guatemala
products.description: For decades, the Aguirre family of Finca El Injerto have pushed the boundaries of quality, innovation, and sustainable farming practices in the coffee world.
products.seo_title: El Injerto Bourbon, Guatemala | Coffee | Offsite

products.name: Mordecofe, Ethiopia
products.description: A complex and floral cup, sparkling with notes of nectarine, melon and jasmine.

products.name: Montañas de Fuego Decaf, Costa Rica
products.description: Always approachable yet delicious, Montañas de Fuego is an exceptional single-origin decaf coffee featuring a soft, drinkable cup with notes of milk chocolate, vanilla, and orange zest.

products.name: Rio de Abejas
products.description: Grown in the stunning highlands of southern Oaxaca, this exceptional single-origin coffee delivers renowned elegance and sweetness with flavors of raisin and chocolate layered atop a silky body.

products.name: Sipi
products.description: Grown in the fertile volcanic soils of Mount Elgon, this exceptional single-origin coffee showcases the potential of Ugandan specialty arabica. It features a juicy body with rich notes of Concord grape and chocolate.

products.name: Wilmer Julca
products.description: This selection from producer Wilmer Julca’s harvest exemplifies the outstanding quality of coffee grown at extremely high elevations in Cajamarca, Peru, featuring notes of orange, cooked fruit, and molasses.

products.name: Night Light Decaf
products.description: Night Light Decaf is a pleasure for pleasure’s sake. As one of our darker coffees, we marvel at how creamy it tastes — no sharp edges, just endless malty sweetness. When served black, it’s smooth yet substantial, the kind of coffee to banish the morning (or evening) chill. With milk or cream, dairy or not, it’s all the richer. Brew it however you like: from espresso to French press, it’s a dream.

products.name: Pedro Nel Trujillo
products.description: This cup from our long-time partner Pedro Nel Trujilio holds a deep caramel sweetness that reminds us of brown sugar and dried plum, while bright citrus notes shine gently like sunlight through morning mist.

products.name: Beneficio San Vicente
products.description: This coffee’s character is defined by a blend of Pacas, Bourbon, Catuai, and IH90 varieties. Through traditional fully washed processing, the producers achieve a clean, articulate profile that captures a transparent sense of place, with a deep sweetness complemented by flavors of dark fruit and citrus.

products.name: Tokyo Kissa
products.description: Tokyo Kissa is our darkest blend yet, inspired by the quiet calm of traditional Japanese kissatens, or coffeehouses, and the dark roasts crafted within them. We embodied the detail, care, and commitment to quality of the kissaten artisans — with their careful sourcing, in-house roasting, and slow, methodical filtering.

products.name: Handmade Matcha Bowl
products.description: These custom ceramic chawan, or matcha bowls, are handmade by local artist Anna Short in the heart of Lancaster, PA. The bowls feature a two-tone design where the interior is finished with a glossy black glaze and the exterior is left raw to show its natural speckled stoneware finish.
